title: list_regions result
description: What list_regions returns: region detail the project context snapshot only counts. This is what turns a request framed by section into a time span — a region's start and end go straight into set_time_selection, and its GUID into a render bounded by region. Each region carries the GUID to address it by, not the index, which REAPER renumbers. totalInRange makes a capped read visible (Requirement 23.9). A read tool, so no undo report.

regions.description: The regions in range, ordered by start position. A region overlapping the window is returned in full rather than clipped to it, so its end may lie outside the window the call asked for.

regionDetail.description: A project region. Its start and end are what turn a request framed by section — "render the chorus" — into a time span, so both are always reported.

index.description: Region index as assigned by REAPER.

end.description: Region end position in seconds. Always greater than start — the extension refuses to write a region that is not (Requirement 9.6).

guid.description: A stable REAPER GUID, in REAPER's own braced form.

timelinePosition.description: A position on the project timeline, in seconds from the start.

color.description: Colour as a six-digit hexadecimal RGB string prefixed with #.

totalInRange.description: How many entries matched the call's filters before maximumResults capped the returned list. Equal to the length of the returned array when nothing was capped. Carried so that a capped read is visible to the agent rather than a silent truncation it reasons over as if it were the whole set (Requirement 23.9).

truncated.description: True when totalInRange exceeds the number of entries returned. Stated rather than left to be inferred from comparing two numbers, so the agent has to notice it before telling the producer the list is complete.
